sources.water_geometry_policy: Unmodified original geographic water geometry; invalid or missing polygons fail. No repair, buffer, rounding, snapping, invented boundary or omission based on coverage.
sources.limitations: The project's original Natural Earth national assignment is retained exactly. Its generalized border/coast uncertainties remain; the independently measured more detailed OSM national proposal is not integrated because it would change neighbouring country assignments. This physical correction does not certify administrative borders or resolve remaining gaps.
